segments.text: The protagonist suffers from amnesia. His background is unknown, but he was in possession of documents indicating that he was sent to Kanai Ward as a detective-in-training at an agency in the city. He participates in ongoing investigations. A lack of self-confidence results in a tendency to frequently complain. However, he possesses a strong sense of justice and selflessly tries to help anyone in need.

A death god contracted to haunt Yuma. She usually appears in her spirit form. Only visible to Yuma, Shinigami is constantly floating and bobbing along at his side. Though cheerful and chatty, this death god’s sense of morality is quite far removed from that of humans. Her words and actions sometimes confuse Yuma. In the Mystery Labyrinth she transforms into a humanoid form and has the power to intervene in matters.
Head of the only agency in Kanai Ward, the Nocturnal Detective Agency.

An aloof and elusive man. Although not a Master Detective, he is certified by the World Detective Organization, which suggests he is an excellent detective. That said, he is somewhat weak-kneed, and his agency's policy is to stay quiet and refrain from any overt behavior that might lead to conflict with the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.
From official website
One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. Their Forte is Postcognition.

Halara is always cool under fire and has solved many difficult cases through precise judgement. Halara only believes in money and will not accept a request without payment, regardless of who the client may be.
From official website

segments.text: One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. His Forte is Disguise.

A young man with a goofball nature who likes hitting on women under the guise of investigation. Desuhiko's goal is to become famous as a mystery-solving superstar detective. He carries a huge backpack filled with tools necessary for his disguises.
From official website

cast.characterName: フブキ＝クロックフォード
cast.originalCharacterName: フブキ＝クロックフォード

segments.text: One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. Her Forte is Time Leap.
Because of her upbringing as a lady of the world-famous Clockford Family, she is a bit naive. She has a uniquely peculiar way of thinking, which can frustrate and confuse the people she talks to.
From official website

cast.characterName: ヴィヴィア＝トワイライト
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴィヴィア＝トワイライト

segments.text: One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. His Forte is Spectral Projection.

He has a decadent and aesthetic atmosphere about him. Often lying down in various places, such as the fireplace at the agency or under the hotel's grand piano, his personality can be described as self-indulgent.
[From official website
Top detective of the World Detective Organization.
He is almost never seen in public and his true identity is unknown. The detectives refer to him only by the nickname Number One.
He gives orders to the detectives in Kanai Ward via a direct line from headquarters.
[From official website

He is eventually revealed to be a body double for the actual Number One. The body double appeared to be killed during a bombing on the World Detective Organization headquarters through news footage, but it was revealed in the Epilogue that the news footage was fake and created by Makoto.
A girl living in Kanai Ward who has a fascination with detectives.
She's quick to get along with anyone she meets due to her excellent communication skills. She is a student at Aetheria Academy and is a member of the theater club.
From official website
A mysterious masked man who lives on the top floor of Kanai Tower.
His tendency to speak in riddles makes it difficult to ascertain his true nature, but he seems to have ulterior motives.
From official website
Top detective of the World Detective Organization.
He is almost never seen in public and his true identity is unknown. The detectives refer to him only by the nickname Number One.
He made a pact with Shinigami-Chan for power at the cost of his memory, and exchanged identities with trainee detective Yuma.

cast.characterName: エイフェックス＝ローガン
cast.originalCharacterName: エイフェックス＝ローガン

segments.text: Born to lawyer parents, he lost them at an early age and lived a rough life in the slums from then on. Due to these circumstances, he tends to be rude and tries to solve problems with violence.

cast.characterName: ジルチ＝アレクサンダー
cast.originalCharacterName: ジルチ＝アレクサンダー

segments.text: He loves the harmony between people and nature and specializes in dealing with those who would try to disrupt it. His tendency toward leading the conversation and moving things along efficiently sometimes gives off the impression of arrogance to those around him.
He is fastidious, conceited, and patronizing, with a tendency toward leading the conversation and moving things along a logical order.

Despite her child-like appearance, she has machine-like composure and mental processing speed. Perhaps because she avoids communication, she sometimes shows awkward reactions and intense displays of emotion during conversation.

cast.characterName: メラミ＝ゴールドマイン
cast.originalCharacterName: メラミ＝ゴールドマイン

segments.text: A glamorous woman with a keen intellect behind her flamboyant appearance. She's a fashionista whose mind is often focused on clothes. She's quick to like anyone with a body type that would suit her favorite outfits.

cast.characterName: ヨミー・ヘルスマイル
cast.originalCharacterName: ヨミー・ヘルスマイル

segments.text: The director of the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.

Despite having the face of a handsome young man, he is ruthless, finding joy in the misfortune of others, tearing people down, and even treating his underlings like expendable tools. He rules Kanai Ward with force and has established power within Amaterasu with his achievements.
From official website
The vice director of the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.

She is Yomi's right hand and takes pride in the trust and affection he has for her. She has a coercive way with words and actions and has no mercy for those who defy her, becoming obedient only when Yomi is involved.
